messages:
nora: quick heads-up from today: onboarding Tethys LoRA for cust-peregrine. ran the 50-sample quickpack on q4_0 and noticed token-stutter on list items (repeats like '1. Item' then again) in ~3 samples.
liam: are those samples with numbered lists in prompt? sometimes tokenizer merges numerics weirdly.
nora: yes, numbered bullets and some markdown. run command:
```bash
./scripts/quick_eval.py --model tethys-peregrine-lora:q4_0 --promptset quick-50 --seed 7 --batch 4
```
eval-bot: Eval-bot: job 1716123470 started for tethys-peregrine-lora:q4_0
liam: try q8_0 as comparison, and run with --token-stats to capture per-token probs. also try disabling prefix cache in case caching duplicates leading tokens.
yvonne: also check merge order; cust-peregrine adapters include a tiny prompt encoder that assumes token ids unchanged. if remap applied after merge, it could cause off-by-one in special tokens.
nora: we'll do A/B: remap-before-merge vs remap-after-merge, and q4_0 vs q8_0. kicking off jobs now.
liam: ping infra-runtime if q4_0 shows skewed softmax at top-k and differences in kernel selection.
nora: kicked off: A=1716123490, B=1716123520, C=1716123550 (q8_0 baseline)
nora: quick note: these are small smoke runs but want to capture artifacts. will add failing sample ids to "cust-peregrine-smoke" and create an Optimize alert for token-stutter >1%
liam: thanks.
